basic_info.description: 2 car tandem parking available@ COE in huge 4 car garage space and 2x large storage areas attached to the garage, 1 walk in wine storage tasting room and will be delivered vacant at COE. Possible ADU opportunity. Major elective seismic reinforcement project in 2012 (plans available). There is a shared garden space with planter boxes and ample space for outdoor tables/chairs. Each unit has a dedicated storage space at basement level. All units have individual laundry machines.
